summary: Frontend-only test of the new Legal feature (Política de Privacidad and Términos de Uso) on the VitrinaAutomotriz Expo web preview. All 6 requested acceptance criteria pass: Info tab shows a 'Legal' section with row-privacidad and row-terminos; tapping row-privacidad opens legal-screen with the expected title 'Política de Privacidad y Seguridad', entity 'VitrinaAutomotriz.cl — Grupo Moller SpA', last-updated pill and headings (Introducción, '1. Qué información recopilamos'); tapping row-terminos shows 'Términos de Uso Obligatorio' with sections 1, 2 and 8, plus the highlighted strong disclaimer block 'NO PRESTAMOS SERVICIOS AUTOMOTRICES...'; legal-back returns to the Info tab in both cases; ScrollView content is scrollable and long content reaches strong blocks/point 12/13. Regression: Inicio, Categorias, Favoritos and Mapa tabs still navigate and render without error. No red screens, no console errors (only benign RN Web deprecation warnings about shadow*/pointerEvents that are library-level and out of scope for this feature).
critical_code_review_comments: legal.tsx uses index (i) as React key when mapping data.blocks — acceptable here since the array is static/constant, but a stable id would be safer if the doc is ever mutated.

In legal.tsx the fallback `LEGAL[doc || 'privacidad'] || LEGAL.privacidad` silently coerces unknown doc query params to privacidad; consider showing a 404-like state or logging for debuggability. Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is stable and verified via mobile web viewport (390x844). testIDs available: info-screen, row-privacidad, row-terminos, legal-screen, legal-back. Route pattern: /legal?doc=privacidad|terminos, registered in app/_layout.tsx.
